trial_court: III Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Mysuru (M.C.No.842/2021)
case_name: Smt Supriya L vs Sri Ravi V
facts_of_case: Marriage was solemnized on 30.01.2018. Due to differences, petitioner/wife is staying with her parents at Hospet. Respondent/husband instituted M.C.No.842/2021 seeking dissolution of marriage.

legal_principles.principle: The court may transfer a petition to another court in the interest of justice and equity.
legal_principles.held: Perused the Civil Petition papers. The petitioner/wife is not working and she has no income of her own. The petitioner/wife is residing with her parents at Hospet and depending on her parents for her livelihood.

legal_principles.principle: The court may not transfer a petition to another court if it would cause hardship to the other party.
legal_principles.held: Further, it is submitted that respondent/husband has to look after his aged parents and it would be difficult for respondent/husband to travel from Mysuru to Hospet and it would cause great hardship, if the proceedings is transferred to Hospet.

outcome.final_order: Petition transferred from III Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Mysuru to the Court of Principal Senior Civil Judge, Hospet, Bellary District.
